notes.title: WILL: Follow The Light Shines at MIX Seattle
notes.content:
This Friday we had the pleasure of showcasing WILL: Follow The Light at the Media Indie Exchange in Seattle — and we want to thank everyone who stopped by! To those who watched, played our demo, and shared valuable feedback with us — your support means the world. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/5684ec39ae5d3622301933f3b9e3820d826f3be4.jpg"]
Special thanks to the MIX organizers for the opportunity to present our game at such a wonderful event!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/1a317141e1df9e0a378036408ef661dc3045c33d.png"]
And of course, thanks to every player around the globe for wishlisting, supporting us, and signing up for playtests — registrations are still open, so don’t miss your chance to join! ⛵

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/05d95fed4ccdfe281b9e66c11655542df864f2da.jpg"]

notes.title: Developer Deep Dive — June 2025
notes.content:
Can a game move you without combat, enemies, or constant deaths? At TomorrowHead Studio, we believe it can.

We're working to create a seamless harmony between a realistic visual style – capturing the harsh northern environment – and a deep, emotional story of a father searching for his missing son. Making a game without a HUD or objective markers is a real challenge, but that’s the goal: to make the journey as immersive and authentic as possible.

[previewyoutube=vGz5UcafG5k;full][/previewyoutube]

In our new behind-the-scenes video, our Lead Level Designer Eugenia Pavlenko shares the design philosophy behind WILL: Follow The Light.
Watch the full video and let us know what you think – your feedback means everything to us!

notes.title: London Games Festival, here we come!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that our game will be featured in the Official Selection of the London Games Festival!

On 3 and 4 April, you will have an exclusive chance to try our demo at London Museum Spaces!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/4806cccc58aa9222d7fb84e84b3886969d291c12.jpg

TomorrowHead Studio is proud to present WILL: Follow The Light in the NARRATIVE EXCELLENCE category along with other amazing indie games:

🔘 Button Man by StyraxStudios

See you there next month, guys!
